# 診斷：`coding_agents` 角色在 noRoot 主機上踩到的兩個坑

## 真正的問題：`npm_check` 抓到的是 system `/usr/bin/npm`（Node 12.22.9）

你的直覺完全正確。問題不是 `noRoot mode` 旗標沒運作 — 而是 [`coding_agents/tasks/main.yml:126-130`](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml#L126) 用的是：

```yaml
- name: Check if npm is available
  ansible.builtin.command: which npm
```

在 `jingle207` (Ubuntu 22.04) 上這會回傳 **`/usr/bin/npm`**（apt 裝的、Node v12.22.9、npm 8.5.1）。然後 [line 139-147](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml#L139) 跟 [line 188-196](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml#L188) 用 `community.general.npm` + `global: true` 去呼叫它，npm 預設 prefix 是 `/usr/local`，當然就 `EACCES: permission denied, mkdir '/usr/local/lib/node_modules'`。

順帶一提，那個 `noRoot mode enabled` 的 banner（log line 34-46）只是 bootstrap 階段的一個 info 訊息，跟實際 ansible 行為沒掛鉤 — 它沒有變成任何 `when:` 條件。

## 既有的正確模式就在隔壁角色

[`devtools/tasks/main.yml:1184-1200`](dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml#L1184) 裝 `tldr` 用的就是你想要的方法（log line 187 也跑成功了 16s）：

```yaml
ansible.builtin.shell: |
  if [ -x "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise" ]; then
    {{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise exec -- npm install -g tldr
  elif command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mise exec -- npm install -g tldr
  else
    echo "mise not found, skipping tldr install" >&2
    exit 0
  fi
```

mise exec 會用 `~/.local/share/mise/installs/node/<v22>/...` 的 Node + npm，prefix 也指到那邊，shim 自動丟到 `~/.local/bin/{github-copilot-cli,codex,gemini,openchamber}` — 完全 no sudo、不污染 `/usr/local`、而且 Node 版本夠新所以 EBADENGINE 警告也消失。

受影響的 npm 任務（全都應該換成 mise 路徑）：

| Task | Line | 目前狀態 |
|---|---|---|
| Install GitHub Copilot CLI | 139 | `ignore_errors: true` → 失敗但被吞 |
| Install OpenAI Codex CLI (Linux fallback) | 188 | **沒有 `ignore_errors`** → hard fail，整個 play 在這裡停了 |
| Install Gemini CLI (Linux) | 244 | 因為 Codex 先 fail 所以根本沒跑到 |
| Install OpenChamber | 1093 | 同上，被跳過 |

## 次要問題：Codex 任務缺 `ignore_errors`

對照 Copilot ([line 147](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml#L147)) 有 `ignore_errors: true`，但 Codex Linux fallback ([line 188](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml#L188)) 沒有。這就是為什麼 `PLAY RECAP` 看到 `failed=1` 而且 `skipped=274` — 整個 play 在 Codex 那一步就 abort，後面 `Gemini`、`OpenChamber`、`claude-hud` 全沒跑。

## 建議的修法

要我直接動手改 `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml`，把 Copilot / Codex / Gemini / OpenChamber 四個 npm-global 任務改成跟 `tldr` 一樣的 `mise exec -- npm install -g ...` shell 區塊嗎？順便補上 Codex 缺的 `failed_when: false` / `ignore_errors: true`，避免下次再 cascade。

  register: tldr_recheck

  args:

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-04-27 14:15:52Z)**_

This role uses "prefer npm, fall back to mise" — wrong order for Linux noRoot (system npm exists but its `/usr/local` prefix is unwritable). Let me invert it: always prefer mise when available, fall back to system npm only if mise is missing.

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-7 2026-04-27 14:16:04Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```yaml
---
# Install standalone JS/npm CLI utilities globally.
#
# Prefers `mise exec -- npm` because system npm on noRoot Linux hosts has its
# prefix at /usr/local (unwritable without sudo). mise's user-managed Node
# prefix works on both Linux and macOS without sudo. System npm is used only
# as a fallback when mise is unavailable.

- name: Detect whether npm is on PATH
  ansible.builtin.command: npm --version
  register: js_cli_npm_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Locate user-installed mise (js_cli_tools)
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"
  register: js_cli_mise_user_bin

- name: Set mise binary path (user install)
  when: js_cli_mise_user_bin.stat.exists | default(false)
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    js_cli_mise_bin: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/mise"

- name: Detect system-installed mise (js_cli_tools)
  when: js_cli_mise_bin is not defined
  ansible.builtin.command: mise --version
  register: js_cli_mise_system_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Set mise binary path (system install)
  when:
    - js_cli_mise_bin is not defined
    - js_cli_mise_system_check.rc == 0
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    js_cli_mise_bin: mise

- name: Warn when neither mise nor npm is available
  when:
    - js_cli_mise_bin is not defined
    - js_cli_npm_check.rc != 0
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: >-
      js_cli_tools: neither mise nor npm found on PATH -- skipping
      {{ js_cli_tools | map(attribute='name') | list | join(', ') }}.
      Ensure Node.js is available (e.g. via the lazyvim_deps role) and re-run.

# --- Check which tools are already installed (idempotency) ---
- name: Check whether each js_cli_tool binary is present
  ansible.builtin.command: command -v {{ item.binary }}
  register: js_cli_tool_presence
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false
  loop: "{{ js_cli_tools }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.binary }}"

- name: Build list of tools still missing
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    js_cli_tools_to_install: >-
      {{
        js_cli_tool_presence.results
        | selectattr('rc', 'ne', 0)
        | map(attribute='item')
        | list
      }}

# --- Install via mise npm (preferred: user-level, no sudo) ---
- name: Install missing js_cli_tools via mise npm
  when:
    - js_cli_mise_bin is defined
    - js_cli_tools_to_install | length > 0
  ansible.builtin.shell: |
    {{ js_cli_mise_bin }} exec -- npm install -g {{ item.name }}
  args:
    executable: /bin/bash
  register: js_cli_mise_npm_install
  until: js_cli_mise_npm_install is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 5
  changed_when: true
  loop: "{{ js_cli_tools_to_install }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"

# --- Install via system npm (fallback when mise is unavailable) ---
- name: Install missing js_cli_tools via system npm fallback
  when:
    - js_cli_mise_bin is not defined
    - js_cli_npm_check.rc == 0
    - js_cli_tools_to_install | length > 0
  community.general.npm:
    name: "{{ item.name }}"
    global: true
    state: present
  register: js_cli_npm_install
  until: js_cli_npm_install is succeeded
  retries: 3
  delay: 5
  loop: "{{ js_cli_tools_to_install }}"
  loop_control:
    label: "{{ item.name }}"

```

js_cli_tools, bitwarden: prefer mise npm over system npm

Same /usr/local EACCES bug as the prior coding_agents fix: on noRoot
Linux hosts (jingle207) `npm --version` succeeds (system npm exists)
so the role chose the system npm path, then community.general.npm
